artifact.name: Z-Girl Hero Coach — Premium AI Gate Adoption

review.notes: Validates the adoption mechanism. Future Z-Girl production changes must update this receipt with artifact-specific evidence.

ai_uses.purpose: Central premium/AI governance for Z-Girl conversational, voice, reflection, reviewer, and release workflows
ai_uses.user_or_production_value: Automates quality evidence, accessibility/privacy discipline, provenance, and exception surfacing while requiring meaningful positive user impact
ai_uses.human_oversight: Character voice/canon, sensitive youth/privacy decisions, faith/values profile boundaries, reviewer activation, and public release remain human-governed

automation.no_additional_automation_rationale: Routine QA, evidence, provenance, and deployment checks should be automated; character integrity, sensitive-user safeguards, values boundaries, reviewer activation, and public release remain human-controlled.

evidence: Adoption mechanism adds no user-facing friction and supports premium conversational/voice quality enforcement
Directly governs AI conversational and voice value, provenance, automation, and human oversight
Requires explicit beneficial user outcomes and negative-impact review for future Z-Girl changes
Central composite action, read-only permissions, deterministic receipt contract
Makes accessibility evidence a standing requirement for future conversational, audio, and reviewer changes
Does not alter character canon and requires future source/brand evidence
Sensitive-user/privacy and public activation decisions remain human-governed; release authority remains false

exceptions: This receipt validates the gate-adoption mechanism only; it does not approve a Z-Girl voice model, response behavior, faith/values pack, reviewer state, or public release.
